scope.writes: Only this requested research artifact; no repository, code, or board changes.

methodology.source_policy: Official LeetCode problem statements inspected, not copied editorials. Candidate titles, requirements, and source URLs checked.
methodology.relationship_policy: All transfer classifications and invariants are independent pedagogical analysis, not official LeetCode labels.
methodology.freshness_policy: Candidate IDs outside the current canonical set are not automatically unseen. Check learner history before assignment.
methodology.top150_membership: Not verified; do not infer membership or non-membership.
methodology.coverage_policy: Do not force three candidates per anchor. Partial-component and prerequisite-extension edges must not be scored as full same-invariant retention.
methodology.timing_policy: D+3,D+7,D+21 anchor to earliest actual FIRST ATTEMPT, including a guided actual attempt. Never use completion date or reset a historical clock. Earlier assistance unknown remains unknown.
methodology.budget_context: Latest user policy:1–2 substantive scheduled exercises60min;3=75min;4=90min. Engineering120 unchanged. Brief recall does not inflate exercise count.
methodology.spoiler_policy: Coach-facing invariant explanations and selection tags should not be shown in blind learner prompts.
methodology.cutoff: No new guided anchors after roadmap Day150. Days151–154 allow review, repair and fresh similar-pattern transfer of already introduced patterns.

entries.canonical_title: Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock

candidates.title: Maximum Difference Between Increasing Elements
candidates.invariant: For each right endpoint retain the minimum strictly earlier value and best valid ordered difference.
new_prerequisites: Strict positive difference; return -1 instead of0 when no increasing pair.
Different input constraints; do not copy repository-specific null/empty behavior into LeetCode statement.

candidates.title: Best Sightseeing Pair
candidates.invariant: Keep the best score contributed by earlier indices while scanning possible later endpoints.
new_prerequisites: Derive a transformed score using values and index distance; Medium rather than Easy.
Keep exact transformation coach-facing; do not disclose it before independent attempt.

gaps: No third distinct validated blind near-transfer established; do not manufacture one or relabel the original.
notes: LC122 StockII allows multiple transactions and is not a clean transfer of the one ordered-pair invariant.
Existing Day1 narrative records seven assisted practice sessions and three screenshots, zero independent-solve credit, and no confirmed dated actual-attempt event. Preserve all of that.

candidates.title: Largest Positive Integer That Exists With Its Negative
candidates.invariant: Retain earlier values and test the complement before inserting; here the complementary pair sums to zero.
new_prerequisites: Track maximum positive magnitude rather than indices.
Return -1 if no pair exists.

candidates.title: 4Sum II
candidates.invariant: Look up the additive complement of a partial sum.
new_prerequisites: Enumerate sums of pairs from two arrays.
Count pair-sum multiplicities rather than stop after one match.

gaps: Only one clean near-transfer verified; the second is a concept extension.

candidates.title: Find Words That Can Be Formed by Characters
candidates.invariant: Every character's demand must stay within the available supply.
new_prerequisites: Reset the supply independently for each word.
Sum lengths of accepted words.

candidates.title: Groups of Special-Equivalent Strings
candidates.invariant: Equal canonical signatures identify exactly the equivalent strings.
new_prerequisites: Derive separate character counts for even and odd positions.
Count equivalence classes instead of returning all members.

candidates.title: Find Resultant Array After Removing Anagrams
candidates.invariant: A character-multiset signature identifies anagram equivalence.
new_prerequisites: Retain one representative of each adjacent anagram run instead of grouping globally.
access_caveats: Does not test global hash-map grouping.

gaps: No three full grouping transfers verified.
notes: 249 Group Shifted Strings was Premium-blocked in the public read and is not included as a verified candidate.

candidates.title: Construct Product Matrix
candidates.invariant: Exclusive prefix and suffix products combine to exclude the current element.
new_prerequisites: Traverse a matrix in a fixed linear order.
Apply modulo 12345 safely using wide arithmetic or reduced factors.
access_caveats: Do not use modular division; the modulus is composite and some factors are non-invertible.

candidates.title: Find Pivot Index
candidates.invariant: Maintain aggregates strictly to the left and right of the current index.
new_prerequisites: Use sums instead of products and compare the two sides.
Return the first matching index.
access_caveats: A total-minus-prefix solution does not test the original two-pass product construction.

gaps: Only 2906 verifies the full exclusive-product pattern.

candidates.title: Find First Palindromic String in the Array
candidates.invariant: Compared characters at opposite ends agree while the unchecked interval shrinks.
new_prerequisites: Scan multiple lowercase words and return the first palindrome.
access_caveats: Lowercase words remove LC125's filtering and case-normalization requirements.

candidates.title: Valid Palindrome II
candidates.invariant: After consuming the optional deletion, ordinary mirrored-end palindrome checking applies.
new_prerequisites: At the first mismatch, consider deleting either endpoint.
Track the one-deletion budget.

gaps: Second candidate adds a branching decision rather than testing identical validity logic.

entries.canonical_title: Two Sum II - Input Array Is Sorted

candidates.title: Sum of Square Numbers
candidates.invariant: Ordered sums permit discarding one endpoint based on whether the sum is below or above target.
new_prerequisites: Use implicit sorted nonnegative square values up to sqrt(c).
Allow equal endpoints because the same square value may be used twice.
Use wide arithmetic.

candidates.title: Count Pairs Whose Sum is Less than Target
candidates.invariant: A sorted two-pointer frontier moves monotonically as sums cross the target.
new_prerequisites: Sort the input.
Count entire blocks of valid pairs rather than return one pair.

gaps: Only the first is a clean two-pointer decision transfer.

candidates.title: Trapping Rain Water
candidates.invariant: Both can use boundary reasoning, but LC11's dominated-shorter-end proof does not establish the per-position trapped-water invariant.
new_prerequisites: Maintain boundary maxima.
Finalize and accumulate water per position.
access_caveats: Not a verified same-invariant transfer; shared water vocabulary and two pointers are insufficient.

candidates.title: Maximum Erasure Value
candidates.invariant: Advance the left boundary until the expanding window contains no duplicate value.
new_prerequisites: Maintain the window's sum instead of its length.
Use positivity to justify that the largest valid window ending at each right endpoint maximizes its score.

candidates.title: Max Consecutive Ones III
candidates.invariant: A nonnegative window statistic changes monotonically as either boundary moves.
new_prerequisites: Count zeros rather than sum values.
Shrink when invalid and maximize valid length, rather than shrink while a minimum-sum condition remains satisfied.
access_caveats: Tests monotone sliding-window reasoning but reverses the objective and shrink condition.

candidates.title: Subarray Product Less Than K
candidates.invariant: Positive integer products support a monotone valid left boundary.
new_prerequisites: Remove left factors by division.
Handle k<=1.
Count all valid suffixes ending at each position.

gaps: No identical objective/invariant transfer verified; both variants require explicit differences.

candidates.title: Minimum Add to Make Parentheses Valid
candidates.invariant: Maintain unmatched opening parentheses and account for closing parentheses lacking a matching opening.
new_prerequisites: Count repairs instead of returning validity.
access_caveats: One bracket type permits a counter and does not independently test multi-type LIFO matching.

candidates.title: Minimum Remove to Make Valid Parentheses
candidates.invariant: Unmatched opening positions and unmatched closings identify invalid parentheses.
new_prerequisites: Mark necessary removals.
Preserve non-parenthesis letters and reconstruct output.
Justify minimality.

gaps: No verified full multi-type LIFO-validation near-transfer.
No verified direct candidate preserving the restorable prefix-minimum invariant.
notes: 716 Max Stack public official statement was Premium-blocked; popMax also requires deletion of a possibly non-top maximum, so it must not be relabeled as min renamed max.
225 Implement Stack using Queues does not test minimum metadata and is rejected as a direct transfer.

candidates.title: Guess Number Higher or Lower
candidates.invariant: The unknown target remains inside the current ordered interval; each comparison removes an impossible half.
new_prerequisites: Interpret the provided guess API's signs.
Use an overflow-safe midpoint.

candidates.title: Find Smallest Letter Greater Than Target
candidates.invariant: Binary search preserves the first-true boundary.
new_prerequisites: Change the boundary predicate from >= target to > target.
Handle duplicate letters and wraparound.

candidates.title: Find First and Last Position of Element in Sorted Array
candidates.invariant: Use first-true boundary search for >= target and > target.
new_prerequisites: Run two boundary searches.
Handle missing targets, empty arrays, and inclusive range endpoints.

entries.canonical_title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array

candidates.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array II
candidates.invariant: The current interval continues to contain a minimum.
new_prerequisites: Handle inconclusive midpoint/end comparisons caused by duplicates.
Safely discard one equal endpoint.
Explain degradation to worst-case O(n).

gaps: No candidate preserving the original guaranteed logarithmic decision rule verified.

candidates.title: Happy Number
candidates.invariant: Slow and fast states follow the same deterministic successor function; meeting detects a cycle.
new_prerequisites: Compute the digit-square successor.
Distinguish reaching successful fixed point 1.
access_caveats: Applies to Floyd cycle detection, not merely a visited-set implementation.

candidates.title: Reverse Linked List II
candidates.invariant: A reversed processed prefix and untouched suffix remain correctly linked during reversal.
new_prerequisites: Find segment boundaries.
Keep the original segment head as its eventual tail.
Reconnect both ends of the reversed segment.

candidates.title: Merge Sorted Array
candidates.invariant: Select the next extreme from two sorted frontiers to maintain a correct merged region.
new_prerequisites: Write backward into spare array capacity to protect unread values.
access_caveats: Transfers merge-frontier reasoning, not linked-node splicing.

candidates.title: Maximum Twin Sum of a Linked List
candidates.invariant: Midpoint, reverse-second-half, and lockstep traversal align original mirror indices i and n-1-i.
new_prerequisites: Aggregate pair sums rather than weave alternating nodes.
Even-length inputs simplify splitting.
access_caveats: Does not test the final alternating node-weaving invariant.
To assess this pipeline, require an O(1)-auxiliary-space solution; storing list values bypasses reversal.
The memory target is a coaching constraint, not claimed to be an explicit official requirement.

gaps: No full composite including final weave transfer verified.

entries.canonical_title: Remove Nth Node From End of List

candidates.title: Swapping Nodes in a Linked List
candidates.invariant: A fixed gap between pointers identifies the kth node from the end.
new_prerequisites: Also retain the kth node from the start.
Swap values.
access_caveats: Official task asks for value swapping, not node rewiring; does not test deletion.

gaps: Only the positional fixed-gap component transfers.

candidates.title: Clone Graph
candidates.invariant: Each original object maps to exactly one clone and cloned edges preserve original relationships.
new_prerequisites: Graph DFS or BFS.
Arbitrary neighbor lists and cycle-safe discovery.
access_caveats: Transfers the identity-map solution to LC138, not its interleaving trick.

candidates.title: Add Binary
candidates.invariant: Emitted low-order digits plus carry represent the processed partial sum.
new_prerequisites: Use base 2.
Traverse strings from right to left and construct output in reverse order.

candidates.title: Add Two Numbers II
candidates.invariant: Process low-order digits with carry to preserve the partial-sum invariant.
new_prerequisites: Access forward-order digits using stacks or reversal.
access_caveats: The no-input-reversal follow-up needs stacks or another separately established prerequisite.

candidates.title: Longest Square Streak in an Array
candidates.invariant: In a hash set, start a chain only when its predecessor is absent; then follow successors.
new_prerequisites: Change successor x+1 to x*x.
Identify predecessors by exact square roots or build predecessor markers by squaring existing values.
Guard arithmetic overflow.
Return -1 for streak lengths below two.
Use nums[i]>=2 to prove strictly increasing disjoint chains.

notes: 163 Missing Ranges scans sorted gaps, not the unsorted hash-set start-without-predecessor invariant.

candidates.title: 3Sum Closest
candidates.invariant: Sort, fix one element, and move two pointers monotonically according to the sum's relation to target.
new_prerequisites: Track minimum absolute error.
Return a sum instead of enumerating unique triples.
access_caveats: Does not independently test full duplicate-output suppression.

candidates.title: 4Sum
candidates.invariant: After fixing outer elements, solve the remaining ordered pair with the same two-pointer frontier.
new_prerequisites: Fix two elements rather than one.
Suppress duplicates at both fixed positions.
Use wide arithmetic for four values and target.
access_caveats: Recursive k-sum is optional, not a prerequisite.

candidates.title: Parsing A Boolean Expression
candidates.invariant: A completed subexpression reduces to one value, but the parsing state differs from postfix evaluation.
new_prerequisites: Prefix operators.
Delimiter scopes.
Variable operand counts.
Boolean operations.
access_caveats: Not a direct postfix operand-reduction transfer.

gaps: No verified clean direct RPN transfer.
notes: 682 Baseball Game '+' reads prior scores without consuming them; its score-history stack is not a pending-expression-values stack.
1006 Clumsy Factorial adds infix precedence and generated operator order; extension only, not selected as a direct substitute.
227 Basic Calculator II was proposed but not statement-verified in this bounded pass, so it is not an accepted candidate.

candidates.title: Maximum Depth of N-ary Tree
candidates.invariant: Depth is one plus maximum child depth; an empty tree has depth zero.
new_prerequisites: Loop over a children collection instead of two child fields.

candidates.title: Symmetric Tree
candidates.invariant: Paired subtrees must agree in null structure and values before recursively comparing children.
new_prerequisites: Cross-pair left and right children instead of same-side children.

candidates.title: Subtree of Another Tree
candidates.invariant: Use complete paired-subtree equality at a candidate root.
new_prerequisites: Outer traversal over possible roots.
Repeated comparisons and their time complexity.

gaps: Only one clean paired-recursion near-transfer verified.

candidates.title: Binary Tree Level Order Traversal II
candidates.invariant: Queue-layer batching processes exactly one tree depth at a time.
new_prerequisites: Reverse the completed sequence of levels.

candidates.title: N-ary Tree Level Order Traversal
candidates.invariant: Queue-layer batching processes exactly one tree depth at a time.
new_prerequisites: Iterate a children collection.

candidates.title: Recover Binary Search Tree
candidates.invariant: If LC98 was taught by inorder traversal, strict inorder order exposes misplaced values.
new_prerequisites: Identify two swapped values from one or two order violations.
Repair the swapped values.
access_caveats: Does not transfer inherited lower/upper-bound validation.
Morris traversal is not required merely because a constant-space follow-up exists.

gaps: No verified direct candidate for inherited lower/upper-bound method.
notes: 700 Search in a Binary Search Tree is not the same invariant.

candidates.title: Path Sum II
candidates.invariant: The root-to-current accumulated or remaining sum is correct, and acceptance is at leaves only.
new_prerequisites: Maintain path buffers with backtracking or copied state.
Enumerate all valid paths instead of short-circuiting after one.

entries.canonical_title: Kth Smallest Element in a BST

candidates.title: Minimum Absolute Difference in BST
candidates.invariant: Inorder traversal emits BST values in sorted order.
new_prerequisites: Prove that a minimum difference occurs between adjacent sorted values.
Retain previous value and aggregate the minimum over the full traversal.
access_caveats: Does not test kth-rank counting.
Official statement says this is the same problem as 783.
